nws_alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 16 at 11:07AM MST until November 18 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Pocatello ID
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 4 and 8
inches with locally higher amounts at or above 8000 feet.

* WHERE...Bear River Range.  This includes Emigration Summit.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Tuesday to 5 AM MST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions.

discussion.key_messages: - Valley rain and mountain snow will begin this evening and continue into Wednesday morning. The heaviest snow accumulations will be across the southern mountains, where a winter weather advisory remains in effect from this evening through Tuesday evening. - An even colder system will impacts the region Thursday into Friday, with more substantial snowfall expected for all Utah mountains. Light valley snow accumulations are increasing in likelihood by Friday afternoon near 5000 feet, to valley floors Friday night. - Freezing temperatures are increasing in probability for lower Washington County and the Virgin River corridor near Zion National Park Saturday and Sunday morning
